given: User A has an isolated session
a stale unauthorized response arrives after successful renewal
when: the fixture delivers the unauthorized response
then: the trace records whether the renewed session is cleared by the old response

assertions.name: session has renewed access before unauthorized delivery
trace records whether old response cleared the renewed session

limits: Actual React Provider, mounted Timeout hook, reducers, services, and Axios interceptors execute.
Synthetic credentials, controlled adapter, and fake clock isolate the declared predicates.
No native browser, real network, live protected business service, or production environment executes.
Passing observational cases do not approve unresolved policy.

unauthorized_observation.meaning: Old access request remains in the same session epoch. Its TOKEN_INVALID_EXPIRED failure clears the renewed session in this controlled source flow.
